transcript.answer: The check is `assertAllToolsDeclared(registry, table)` in `apps/api/src/oversight/assertAllToolsDeclared.ts`. It takes every name from `registry.getDefinitions()` and looks for each one in the authority table, which is defined in `apps/api/src/oversight/toolAuthority.ts`. If any registered tool has no row, it throws an Error: "The tool authority table has no row for <names>. Declare each registered tool in apps/api/src/oversight/toolAuthority.ts." Per spec FR-004, the api must exit non-zero before the port opens. A server test checks that port 8196 stays unbound in that case. I could not read `server.ts`, so I can't confirm the exact call site. The spec says the engine is built in `apps/api/src/server.ts`, so the call is probably made there during startup. Separately, `authorityOf` in `toolAuthority.ts` treats a tool with no row as `requires_human_action`, so at call time it is denied by default.
sources: specs support-agent oversight spec.md (FR-003, FR-004, FR-008)
